messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — during month-end recon for ACCT: acct_8h7K the dashboard total shows $12,415.22 but the invoice (INV-20260331-AC42) is $13,001.88. Discrepancy ~ $586.66. line items look like tokens vs a mysterious charge. Anyone seen this pattern before?

Josh (Billing Eng): @Maya can you confirm invoice id and whether the customer changed plan in March? I’ll pull raw meter.

Maya (CS): INV-20260331-AC42, account id acct_8h7K. They upgraded from Startup -> Startup Plus on 2026-03-28 15:12 PDT. Dashboard view I'm looking at is the default "Usage" page (only shows token/embedding usage, not plan charges).

Ara (Finance): We need to close books today — is this a billing bug or just a dashboard visibility issue? :eyes:

BillingBot: Invoice INV-20260331-AC42 generated 2026-04-01 02:12 UTC — total $13,001.88 — https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-20260331-AC42

Josh (Billing Eng): Pulling meter. Two quick possibilities: (1) invoice includes a prorated plan upgrade charge that dashboard "Usage" omits, (2) dashboard aggregation window/timezone mismatch (dashboard was showing PST cutoff, invoice uses UTC). I’ll paste the raw meter lines.

Josh (Billing Eng): ```
account_id,usage_start,usage_end,service,units,unit_type,rate,amount
acct_8h7K,2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,2026-03-31T23:59:59Z,generation,1241522000,tokens,0.00001,12415.22
acct_8h7K,2026-03-28T15:12:00Z,2026-03-31T23:59:59Z,plan_prorate,1,one-time,586.66,586.66
```

Sam (Platform Ops): FYI dashboard's "summary" widget intentionally excludes "one-time" and "plan_prorate" charge types. It's a UX choice to keep usage plots uncluttered. Not ideal for month-end recon though.

Maya (CS): So that explains the $586.66 gap. Can we add a note or a toggle for month-end? Customer is asking why dashboard total != invoice.

Josh (Billing Eng): For immediate reconciliation use the invoice as source-of-truth. Repro/export steps for raw data:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/exports?account=acct_8h7K&start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-31&format=csv" > acct_8h7K_mar.csv
```
That CSV will include charge_type column ("usage","one-time","prorate","credits").

Ara (Finance): Good. For close we'll use invoice totals. Can Billing team add a short note on the invoice page saying "Invoice includes prorated plan charges; Dashboard Usage excludes one-time plan charges"?

Josh (Billing Eng): Yep. I'll create a small UI note + a toggle to include one-time charges in the summary view. Filing JIRA: BILL-1129. ETA for UI patch: end of week.

Maya (CS): Thank you. I'll message the customer with the explanation and attach the export.

Sam (Platform Ops): Also opened an internal ticket to document timezone cutoffs: DASH-210. Dashboard default window was PST; invoice generation uses UTC. We'll align docs.

Maya (CS): Marking this thread resolved for now. If customer still disputes after seeing export I'll re-open. :white_check_mark:"
